dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the dorsal ridge, characterized by high-intensity pixel perimeters. These structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior background to the bright boundary edge, with a return to a darker interior intensity at the core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed in the central-lateral region. These blobs show high core pixel concentration and lack any discernible internal intensity gradients, forming a bright, nearly contiguous patch.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the vertex of the obtuse angle oriented toward the mid-dorsal ridge.
